messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert  elevated 5xx and pod restarts on gpu-serving cluster (prod). Possible CUDA OOM during prefill. Paging @Sam (sre-oncall) and @Priya (eng-runtime).

Sam (sre-oncall): Oncall acknowledge. I'm pulling recent pod events and stack traces. Any customer reports yet?

Kei (cs): BigQueryAI reported failed indexing jobs for very large documents starting ~11:07 UTC. They've opened a ticket (INC-2143658701).

Priya (eng-runtime): From stderr dump on model-runtime pods: repeated OOM in prefill path, process exit code 137, immediate restart. Log sample below: 
```
[2026-03-15T11:08:12Z] model-runtime-3 stderr: allocator.cc:401] CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 2684354560 bytes
request_id=req-bq77
model=redwood-long-60b
prefill_tokens=14700
kv_estimate_bytes=3.05GB
```
Looks like a single-request allocation (KV prefill growth + transient kernel buffers) is exceeding GPU RAM. We're also seeing fragmentation spikes making the effective free memory lower than reported.

Jordan (ops): Autoscaler did add nodes but affected pods keep dying during prefill. This is peak-memory per-request, not aggregate.

Priya (eng-runtime): Immediate mitigations proposed: 
- Gate huge requests at ingress: set PREFILL_HARD_LIMIT=8192 to block >8192 tokens.
- Deploy a prefill_shedder sidecar that inspects requests pre-runtime and returns a helpful 413-like payload for oversized prefill.
- Enable PREFILL_STREAMING on a canary subset to reduce peak allocation.
- Taint/cordon the noisy node (gpu-node-11) and drain for log capture.
- Add temporary tenant prefill concurrency cap (2 concurrent prefills per tenant) to prevent retry amplification.

Sam (sre-oncall): Apply the ingress gate and tenant concurrency cap now. I'll cordon the node. Priya, can you bring up the canary for PREFILL_STREAMING?

Priya (eng-runtime): Applying envs and restarting ingress canary: 
```bash
kubectl set env deploy/ingress PREFILL_HARD_LIMIT=8192 -n prod
kubectl set env deploy/model-runtime PREFILL_STREAMING=true -n prod
kubectl patch deploy/ingress -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"canary":"true"}}}}}'
```
Rolling a single ingress canary first. deploy-bot, start canary.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for ingress (ingress-canary-21). Health checks active.

Jordan (ops): Cordon/drain gpu-node-11 now: 
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-11
kubectl drain gpu-node-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```
Node drained for investigation; logs being archived.

Kei (cs): BigQueryAI reports a mix of successes and failures after the gate; they're seeing explicit rejection payloads for some jobs and success for others that were split. They're asking for an ETA for a permanent fix.

Priya (eng-runtime): Canary ingress now returns structured rejection for over-limit prefills: 
```json
{ "error": "prefill_exceeds_limit", "max_prefill_tokens": 8192, "suggestion": "split or use streaming API" }
```
We also added header `X-Prefill-Limit: 8192` to responses so clients can programmatically adapt.

Sam (sre-oncall): Observability check: prefill-related OOM restarts down ~89% since the gate. Posting Kibana query: `log:CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY AND attrs.prefill_tokens:[8193 TO *] AND kubernetes.namespace:prod`.

Priya (eng-runtime): Additional runtime change: enabling PREFILL_STREAMING on canary runtime instances reduces peak memory by performing prefill in windowed chunks and reusing KV buffers. We'll canary to a small subset of models serving long-context customers.

Jordan (ops): Added tenant concurrency throttle rule `prefill_concurrent_limit=2` for 1h rolling window. That should limit retry amplification.

Kei (cs): BigQueryAI confirmed reduced failures when they re-run split jobs. They're asking for a customer-facing note.

Sam (sre-oncall): Handoff prep  I'm going to hand over monitoring to Anya. Summary for Anya: P1 triggered by oversized prefill allocations causing CUDA OOM during prefill; mitigations applied: PREFILL_HARD_LIMIT=8192 at ingress, PREFILL_STREAMING canary, tenant concurrency cap = 2, quarantined gpu-node-11. OOMs down ~89%. Follow-ups for eng-runtime and platform.

Anya (sre-oncall-next): Taking over. I'll watch the dashboard and alert thresholds. Any outstanding hotfixes?

Priya (eng-runtime): Hotfixes / follow-ups to include in postmortem: 
- Change allocator to pre-reserve KV buffer with a safety margin (kv_reserve_factor=1.2) to avoid mid-prefill crashes due to transient kernel buffers and fragmentation.
- Implement server-side streaming fallback automatically when projected prefill > 75% of GPU capacity.
- Add per-tenant histogram & alert when tenant 95th pct > 70% of PREFILL_HARD_LIMIT.
- Provide SDK helper to chunk very long documents and surface the X-Prefill-Limit header.
- Add a `prefill_shedder` lightweight sidecar prototype for graceful rejections with hints and estimated chunk counts.

Sam (sre-oncall): Recording incident INC-2143658701 and assigning action items to eng-runtime (Priya) and platform (Jordan).

Priya (eng-runtime): Sample canary runtime log showing graceful reject before OOM: 
```
[2026-03-15T11:25:33Z] runtime-canary info: req=req-mk9 prefill_requested=14700 prefill_allowed=8192 prefill_streamed=true returned=413
```
This prevented further container restarts from that request.

Jordan (ops): Node logs for gpu-node-11 uploaded to S3 at s3://redwood-incident-logs/2143658701/gpu-node-11.tar.gz for eng-runtime to inspect memory allocator traces.

Kei (cs): I'll draft a short customer advisory: "We experienced transient failures for very large single-shot prefill requests. A temporary hard limit and streaming path have been applied; please split very large uploads or enable streaming. No data loss; most jobs succeed when split." Will coordinate with Priya for technical wording.

Anya (sre-oncall-next): Monitoring stable for now. I'll escalate if OOMs creep back up above threshold.

incident-bot: Incident 2143658701  mitigated. Please attach the postmortem when available.

Priya (eng-runtime): Final root-cause note for postmortem: allocator didn't account for packed-kernel transient buffers + fragmentation during large prefill; pre-reserve + streaming fallback will be shipped.

Sam (sre-oncall): Final customer impact summary: ~9 tenants observed failures or retries; main impact = failed single-shot large prefill jobs and increased latency for others due to retries. No persisted user data lost. Marking incident mitigated at 11:44 UTC. Thanks team. :white_check_mark: :thumbsup:
